facts.fact: GeezLab's GLaRe programme lists open Tigrinya datasets, including the TiNC24 NER corpus (200K+ words) and the TiPOSC24 part-of-speech corpus (118K+ tokens), both led by students at Mai Nefhi College of Engineering.
GeezLab lists Dahlak LMs, a family of language models trained on Eritrean languages, as in progress.
